name: Bhatia Communications & Retail (India) Limited
about: Bhatia Communications & Retail (India) Limited engages in retail and wholesale distribution of mobile handsets, tablets, data-cards, mobile accessories, and mobile related products in India. The company is also involved in retail distribution of home appliances, such as smart, LED, and LCD TVs; and air conditioners and coolers, microwaves, refrigerators, washing machines, and other home appliances. It operates through a network of retail and franchised stores. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Surat, India.
